latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of script-git-manager skill.
- Enforces script creation and modification with strict Git versioning: one script per directory, each with an isolated Git repository.
- Requires and manages all Python dependencies via a dedicated virtual environment at ~/.nanobot/workspace/venv.
- Always presents a detailed plan for user confirmation before any action, and reports progress after every step.
- Prevents unintended file creation, modifications, or state changes; only acts on explicit user instructions.
